label: @bayarea NANDA Chapter
description: Community hub for the SF Bay Area NANDA chapter. Answers chapter questions, manages a member agent registry, and routes messages to member agents.

skills.description: Answer questions about Bay Area chapter members, resources, events, and focus areas
Match people to collaborators based on skills, interests, and availability
Register and discover member agents within this chapter via /api/members and /nanda/index
Route @agent-id messages to registered member agents
